title: DEC-240 CI hardening: remaining low and info findings from the OMARK-102 round-1 review (not started)
description: Filed from the Opus round-1 review of opum-ai/opum-marketplace#235 (OMARK-102), relayed by the leader 2026-10-28. All predate that PR and none is started. Relayed wording, not read from the reviewer record. LOW-3: the workflow-hardening rules run per line, not per command, and comments are not stripped, so an npm ci with the flag followed by && npm rebuild passes, and an npm install with the flag only inside a trailing comment passes. LOW-4: layout evasions of the line reader: a run key with two spaces after the dash, a quoted run key, a flow-style mapping, run with an indentation indicator or a trailing comment after the block marker, and *.yaml workflow files skipped by the .yml filter. LOW-5 remainder: extensions.worktreeConfig with a .git/config.worktree file evades --local; url insteadOf rewrites, a token in remote.origin.url and credential.helper are INFO only. LOW-6: a whitespace-only managed block reports no Quest CLI line instead of empty. LOW-2 remainder: npm subcommands the pattern does not list (update, dedupe, audit fix, link, install abbreviations, ic, sit, init, create) and quoted or path-prefixed npm. PROPOSAL, not a decision: a job-level npm_config_ignore_scripts set to true would make the lint a backstop instead of the only control. That is a CI-design change for the leader and opum-doc to decide.

acceptanceCriteria.text: each listed finding is fixed or recorded as declined with a reason
a fixture or mutant proves each fixed finding both ways in the suite itself
the npm_config_ignore_scripts proposal is decided or declined by its owner and the answer recorded
